-- Phase 1: declarations and signatures only. Bodies are placeholders.

-- True only for a bare file name: no separators, no "..", not empty.
safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex safe_name("a.txt") == True
  ex safe_name("../x") == False
  if name == ""
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "/" or c == "\\" or c == ":"
      return False
  name != "." and name != ".."

-- Returns the text of the first readable file in names, read from inside notes/.
-- Returns "" when no name yields a readable file.
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  pre names.len() >= 0
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      if safe_name(name)
        let text = fs.read(name) else continue
        return text
  ""
